name: StreamElements
what_it_is: StreamElements is a cloud-based streaming platform with overlays, alerts, a chatbot, tipping, merchandise tools, an OBS plugin (SE.Live) and the multistreaming companion app Ground Control.
platforms: Twitch, YouTube and Facebook Gaming, per the vendor
pricing: Pricing is not stated on the home page opened.
notable: Describes itself as cloud-based and integrated with the stream
Ground Control is described as an all-in-one multistreaming management companion app

facts.fact: StreamElements lists overlays, tipping, chatbot, alerts and merchandise among its features for Twitch, YouTube and Facebook Gaming.
SE.Live is a plugin for OBS Studio, and Ground Control is a multistreaming stream management companion app.
The StreamElements home page opened does not show a price.
